reason: Everything already works on my one WhatsApp phone and my register, and with only 3 girls I can see who is in which chair myself. Paying ₹4,999 upfront plus ₹999 every month, even in slow months, for something my staff have to learn in English is not worth it right now.
objection: My staff won't keep doing selfies and typing every bill into an app; after two weeks they'll go back to WhatsApp and I'll be paying ₹999 a month for nothing.
would_change_my_mind: No setup fee and a Hindi option, with the first month showing me the reminder messages actually brought old customers back.
